munit:test.name: cdm-marketplace-order-becomes-canonical-and-both-targets
munit:test.description: Canonical data model: a marketplace JSON order becomes the canonical order, an invoicing request with the total and a warehouse CSV pick list

munit:payload.value: #[output application/json --- {id: 'MK-501', buyer: {accountId: 'A-9'}, shipping: {country: 'br'}, lines: [{listing: {sku: 'SKU-BOOK'}, units: 2, price: {amount: '30.00', currency: 'BRL'}}, {listing: {sku: 'SKU-MUG'}, units: 1, price: {amount: '12.50', currency: 'BRL'}}]}]

munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Canonical order
munit-tools:assert-that.is: #[MunitTools::equalTo({orderId: 'ORD-MK-501', source: 'MARKETPLACE', customerId: 'CUS-A-9', country: 'BR', currency: 'BRL', items: [{sku: 'SKU-BOOK', quantity: 2, unitPrice: 30}, {sku: 'SKU-MUG', quantity: 1, unitPrice: 12.5}]})]

munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Warehouse CSV rows
munit-tools:assert-that.is: #[MunitTools::equalTo(['SKU-BOOK x2 to BR', 'SKU-MUG x1 to BR'])]

munit:test.name: cdm-partner-xml-gives-the-same-target-documents
munit:test.description: Canonical data model: the same order as a partner XML purchase order gives the same canonical items and the same target documents; only the ids and the source differ

munit:payload.value: #[output application/xml --- {PurchaseOrder @(number: 'PO-77', currency: 'BRL'): {Customer @(code: 'A-9'): null, ShipTo @(country: 'BR'): null, Lines: {Line @(sku: 'SKU-BOOK', quantity: '2', unitPrice: '30.00'): null, Line @(sku: 'SKU-MUG', quantity: '1', unitPrice: '12.50'): null}}}]

munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Same canonical items as the marketplace order
Same invoicing lines and total
munit-tools:assert-that.is: #[MunitTools::equalTo({customer: 'CUS-A-9', currency: 'BRL', lines: [{sku: 'SKU-BOOK', qty: 2, amount: 60}, {sku: 'SKU-MUG', qty: 1, amount: 12.5}], total: 72.5})]

munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Same warehouse rows
munit-tools:assert-that.is: #[MunitTools::equalTo(['SKU-BOOK x2 to BR', 'SKU-MUG x1 to BR'])]

munit:test.name: cdm-module-target-translators-need-only-the-canonical-order
munit:test.description: Canonical data model (module test, no flow): the invoicing and warehouse translators are called with a canonical order alone, with no source format involved

munit:payload.value: #[output application/java --- {orderId: 'ORD-C-1', source: 'ANY', customerId: 'CUS-1', country: 'PT', currency: 'EUR', items: [{sku: 'SKU-EBOOK', quantity: 3, unitPrice: 9}]}]

munit-tools:assert-that.is: #[MunitTools::equalTo({invoiceFor: 'ORD-C-1', customer: 'CUS-1', currency: 'EUR', lines: [{sku: 'SKU-EBOOK', qty: 3, amount: 27}], total: 27})]

munit:test.name: cdm-module-target-translator-rejects-an-order-that-is-not-canonical
munit:test.description: Canonical data model (module test, no flow): the invoicing translator takes a CanonicalOrder, so an order without currency fails at the call instead of producing an invoice without one

set-variable.doc:name: SET vInvoice
set-variable.value: #[dwl::canonical::ToInvoicing::fromCanonical({orderId: 'ORD-C-2', source: 'ANY', customerId: 'CUS-1', country: 'PT', currency: null, items: [{sku: 'SKU-EBOOK', quantity: 3, unitPrice: 9}]})]

munit:test.name: cdm-partner-order-without-currency-returns-400
munit:test.description: Canonical data model: a partner purchase order without a currency attribute fails the canonical validation with 400; no currency is assumed

munit:payload.value: #[output application/xml --- {PurchaseOrder @(number: 'PO-79'): {Customer @(code: 'A-9'): null, ShipTo @(country: 'BR'): null, Lines: {Line @(sku: 'SKU-BOOK', quantity: '1', unitPrice: '30.00'): null}}}]

munit:test.name: cdm-marketplace-order-in-two-currencies-returns-400
munit:test.description: Canonical data model: a marketplace order whose lines are in two currencies cannot become one canonical order: 400

munit:set-event.doc:name: Marketplace order MK-503 in BRL and USD

munit:payload.value: #[output application/json --- {id: 'MK-503', buyer: {accountId: 'A-9'}, shipping: {country: 'BR'}, lines: [{listing: {sku: 'SKU-BOOK'}, units: 1, price: {amount: '30.00', currency: 'BRL'}}, {listing: {sku: 'SKU-MUG'}, units: 1, price: {amount: '3.00', currency: 'USD'}}]}]

munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Currency rule named
munit-tools:assert-that.is: #[MunitTools::equalTo('currency must be one ISO 4217 code for the whole order')]

munit:test.name: cdm-marketplace-order-without-buyer-returns-400
munit:test.description: Canonical data model: a marketplace order without buyer fails the canonical validation with 400, and the message names the canonical field

munit:payload.value: #[output application/json --- {id: 'MK-502', shipping: {country: 'BR'}, lines: [{listing: {sku: 'SKU-BOOK'}, units: 1, price: {amount: '30.00', currency: 'BRL'}}]}]

munit:test.name: cdm-partner-line-with-bad-quantity-returns-400
munit:test.description: Canonical data model: a partner line whose quantity is not a number is caught by the same canonical validation, with 400

munit:payload.value: #[output application/xml --- {PurchaseOrder @(number: 'PO-78', currency: 'BRL'): {Customer @(code: 'A-9'): null, ShipTo @(country: 'BR'): null, Lines: {Line @(sku: 'SKU-BOOK', quantity: 'two', unitPrice: '30.00'): null}}}]

munit-tools:assert-that.doc:name: Item rule named
munit-tools:assert-that.is: #[MunitTools::equalTo('every item needs a sku, a quantity above zero and a unit price')]
